name: Brooklyn Heights Riverfront Campground
evidence: operator camp map v17 + site sheet: RV6-RV10 sit on the inland side of Brooklyn Heights Rd, 'along the river only separated by the dead end road'; RV1-RV4 behind the lodge/RF1 strip; leaf-off Esri at 39.0712,-79.6222: road runs on the bank -> road between pads and water, river in front = riverview

name: Bluestone State Park
evidence: satellite at 37.6115,-80.9340 (Meador CG): east-spur pads on a bench ~448 m vs water 429 m (Open-Meteo DEM transect), graded slope to a slough and wooded bar, open lake ~100 m off; south loops behind tree band ~150 m; WVSP park map is overview-only; 'lakeside' is marketing

name: Eagle's Nest Campground
evidence: satellite at 39.5355,-78.7475 (250 m frame): easternmost RV row ~30-40 m from Patterson Creek behind a continuous wooded riparian strip, no sightline; operator 'near water' is marketing, no per-site map

name: Blue Heron Landing
evidence: operator campground map: creek-side spots on Kayak Cove Rd are tent sites 1-4, River RV (a rental camper) and cabins; numbered RV sites 1-61 set back behind treeline; satellite at 38.8763,-81.8317 and 38.8778,-81.8332 confirms rows ~40 m+ from Mill Creek behind trees

name: Gauley Tailwaters Campground
evidence: below Summersville Dam, judged on the Gauley tailwater only; satellite at 38.2150,-80.8895: gravel-strip sites ~60 m from the river behind a continuous tree band; NPS: 18 drive-in sites, no shoreline per-site data

name: Glade Creek Campground
evidence: Esri canopy-blind; WVGISTC leaf-off at 37.8283,-81.0125: restroom + gravel lane ~30 m from Glade Creek through woods, pads not resolvable; NPS lists 6 walk-in tent + 5 drive-in sites, no per-site map or shoreline flag -> default down

name: Big Rock Campground
evidence: rec.gov 10351767 site coords (5 sites, ~38.2961) + WVGISTC leaf-off at 38.2961,-80.5240: spurs north of FR 76, ~45-50 m from the Cranberry with the road and a wooded bank strip between; Esri in-leaf screened; matches --AWH 'across the road, sites are not waterfront'

name: Horseshoe Recreation and Campground Area
evidence: WVGISTC leaf-off at 39.1812,-79.6008: campground loop ~45-100 m east of Horseshoe Run behind woodland, mowed meadow by the creek is the day-use pavilion field; rec.gov 232006 per-site records carry no Proximity to Water/shoreline flag
